answer_1.quote: Speech LLMs have been extended to encompass a broader range of applications, including audio event detection and audio captioning.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text responses based on input audio and prompts, such as transcribing speech (ASR), verifying the number of speakers (SNV), and describing audio content (AC).

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance using word error rate (WER) for ASR tasks, accuracy for SNV, and METEOR for AC.
